Original:
Maain Karbala Ki Maain …
Besar Beton Per Sehra Mein, Kitney Aansu Barsayen
Maain Karbala Ki Maain…
Translation:
Mothers of Karbala...
How many tears they shed over their headless sons in the desert.
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Haye Kiya Zulm Huwa, Bekafan Laashon Say,
Beridaon Nay Kaha Hum Bechadar Hain Bekafnon
Kaisey Tumko Dafnayen
Maain Karbala Ki Maain…
Translation:
Alas, what oppression befell the unshrouded bodies.
The unveiled women cried, 'We ourselves have no veils, and they have no shrouds.'
How can we bury you?
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Aag Khaimon May Lagi,
To Ye Zainab Nay Kaha,
Humko Sajjadd Bata.
Baher Niklein Ya Khaimon Mein Hum Jall Ker Hi Marr Jaayen.
Maain Karbala Ki Maain…
Translation:
When the tents were set ablaze,
Zainab said,
'Tell us, Sajjad,
Should we run outside, or remain in the tents and burn to death?'
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Shimr Badkaar Ne Ye,
Ibne Nofal Say Kaha,
Laa uthha Ker Naiza.
Fizza hon ya Woh Zainab hon
Pal Bhar Na Sone Payen.
Maain Karbala Ki Maain…
Translation:
The wicked Shimr said
To Ibn Nofal,
'Raise your spear.
Whether it is Fizza or Zainab,
Do not let them rest even for a moment.'
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Ye Musibat Hai Badi,
Shaam Aur Kufa Mein,
Aaley Payghambar Per
Jinko Rassi Say Bandha ho
Baaghi Bhi Woh Kehlayen
Maain Karbala Ki Maain…
Translation:
What a great tragedy this was,
In Sham and Kufa,
For the family of the Prophet.
Those bound in ropes
Were even called rebels.
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Jab Rihayi Ki Khabar,
Haye Zindan May Mili,
Ek Kohram Huwa
Choti Bibi Ki Turbat Ko
Sab Gir Gir Ker Liptayen
Maain Karbala Ki Maain..
Translation:
When news of their release
Reached the prison,
A great cry arose.
Everyone fell upon the grave of the little Lady,
Clinging to it in tears.
Mothers of Karbala...

Original:
Qafila Ujda Hua,
Jab Madine Ko Chala,
Aur Ek Ghum Tha naya
Yasir sab Ne Hi Ye Socha
Sughra Ko Kya batlayein.
Translation:
When the devastated caravan
Set out for Madina,
A new sorrow arose.
Everyone wondered,
'What shall we tell Sughra?'
